_comment: Data-source configuration layer. Only the local DEMO files are connected in this prototype. The entries marked PROPOSED are the official source categories envisaged for a validated deployment; none of them is connected and no data from them is used or imitated here.

sources.name: Local prototype/demo CSV + JSON files
sources.description: Synthetic Maharashtra pilot dataset generated by scripts/generate_demo_data.py. Fictional numbers, every row tagged source_type=DEMO.

sources.name: PLFS (Periodic Labour Force Survey)
sources.description: Proposed source for employment structure and labour-force indicators by region and sector.
sources.integration_note: Planned file ingestion of published unit-level / tabulated releases, subject to the data-sharing terms and release schedule of the publishing agency. Access method to be confirmed.

sources.name: NCS (National Career Service)
sources.description: Proposed source for job postings / vacancy signals.
sources.integration_note: Planned integration through an agreed data-sharing arrangement or API if one is made available. No scraping of the live portal.

sources.name: e-Shram
sources.description: Proposed source for unorganised-sector worker registry aggregates (supply side).
sources.integration_note: Planned use of aggregated, anonymised extracts only, under appropriate data-governance approvals.

sources.name: NCO-2015 (National Classification of Occupations)
sources.description: Proposed occupation classification backbone. The demo taxonomy has an nco_mapping column marked PENDING.
sources.integration_note: Planned mapping table from demo occupations to NCO-2015 codes, loaded into app/ml/taxonomy.py.

sources.name: Industry hiring signals
sources.description: Proposed industry-association or employer-provided hiring outlook feeds.
sources.integration_note: Planned partnership-based feeds; format to be agreed.

sources.name: Training / NSQF data
sources.description: Proposed source for training-centre locations, seat capacity, enrolment and qualification levels.
sources.integration_note: Planned file / API ingestion of training-provider capacity data once access is agreed.
